textbookBox.concept: A mineral is a homogenous naturally occurring substance with a definable internal structure. Minerals are found in ores.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A mineral is a homogenous naturally occurring substance with a definable internal structure. Minerals are found in ores.
beats.speakEn: A mineral is a homogenous naturally occurring substance with a definable internal structure. Minerals are found in ores.

beats.en: Minerals occur in igneous and metamorphic rocks as veins and lodes, in sedimentary rocks in layers, as alluvial deposits called placers, and in ocean waters.
beats.speakEn: Minerals occur in igneous and metamorphic rocks as veins and lodes, in sedimentary rocks in layers, as alluvial deposits called placers, and in ocean waters.

textbookBox.concept: Minerals are classified as ferrous (iron, manganese), non-ferrous (copper, bauxite, lead, zinc, tin) and non-metallic (mica, limestone).

beats.en: Minerals are classified as ferrous (iron, manganese), non-ferrous (copper, bauxite, lead, zinc, tin) and non-metallic (mica, limestone).
beats.speakEn: Minerals are classified as ferrous (iron, manganese), non-ferrous (copper, bauxite, lead, zinc, tin) and non-metallic (mica, limestone).

beats.en: Iron ore is the backbone of industry. The main belts are Odisha-Jharkhand, Durg-Bastar-Chandrapur, Ballari-Chitradurga-Chikkamagaluru-Tumakuru and Maharashtra-Goa.
